results.summary: The director keeps an int Gold (starts 0), shows 'Gold: N' in the status lines, and spawns a Purse interactable in the barracks. Interacting once adds 100 and destroys the purse. A bPurseTaken flag blocks a second pickup. Runtime play and the data/asset paths were not run, so this is verified by reading only.

evidence.note: Spawned at the barracks node when the demo floor is built.
HandleInteract adds PurseGold once, sets bPurseTaken, destroys the actor. Reached from ADDDemoCharacter::Interact -> ADDDemoInteractable::Interact -> Director->HandleInteract.
Status text line shown by the HUD.
Demo value 100, labelled as the crew's EXPERIMENTAL value.

results.score_reason: Gold is the currency the toll needs (GDD line 319) and DD-TOLL-02 depends on it. It is already built, so urgency is low.

results.summary: A Boss interactable is spawned at boss_room. Interacting shows bandit_boss_stage_threatening_01 from bandit_strings.csv, with the toll read from faction_stages.json (threatening) and {adventurer_name} filled with the placeholder 'adventurer'. The player is not shown how to pay. The prompt only says 'E Speak to the bandit boss (toll: N gold)', and no pay action exists.

evidence.note: Fills {adventurer_name} and {toll_amount} using TollGold loaded by LoadBanditData.
Spawned in the demo floor build; HandleInteract case Boss shows the threatening line.

evidence.symbol: E  Speak to the bandit boss (toll: %d gold)
evidence.note: Prompt has no pay instruction (for example no Q key).

results.score_reason: The boss is central to the milestone (GDD 385-387). The remaining gap is the pay prompt, which is small and blocks the pay step in DD-TOLL-02.

results.summary: There is no pay action. The Boss case ignores the alt key (Q) and never compares gold with the toll or subtracts it. It also never shows bandit_boss_toll_paid_01 or bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01, and no bTollPaid state exists. The comment in the code says paying is a later requirement.

evidence.note: Searched Source/ for bTollPaid, TollPaid, toll_paid, cannot_pay, and Gold -= or Gold - TollGold. No matches.
The Boss case in HandleInteract only handles the non-alt threatening line.

results.score_reason: This is the core mechanic of the milestone (GDD 385-387). DD-DESC-01 is waiting on it, and its dependencies, gold and boss, are already implemented, so it can be built now.

results.summary: No descent interactable is spawned at node descent. The EDDDemoKind enum has no Descent kind, and there is no barred message, win message or demo-over state.

evidence.note: Searched Source/ for descent (case-insensitive) in .h and .cpp, and for win, victory and bDemoOver. There is no descent interactable or win handling.
The enum ends at Purse and Boss, with no Descent kind.

results.score_reason: Using the descent is the win condition (GDD 44-45, 390) and the milestone cannot finish without it. It depends on DD-TOLL-02, so it comes after that one, and nothing else depends on it.
